name: North Gyeongsang
summary_text: The country dossier lists this division among regions with no sub-national trans signal: no province-specific trans ordinance, incident series or enforcement finding was located. This is an estimated record — its prior characterization as a conservative south-eastern province was model prior, not evidence, and is replaced here by the dossier's null finding. The same three national-level sources as other divisions in this country apply: a Seoul court ruling on police restroom advice, an unrestored Yonhap wire, and a national school-restroom survey — none document North Gyeongsang-specific incidents.

sources.title: Police advice to LGBTQ+ individual to avoid public restrooms ruled as rights violation - The Korea Times
sources.claim_summary: Korea Times (22 Jul 2024): Seoul Central District Court ruled that a police officer advising a person in gender transition to avoid public restrooms for a while was a human-rights infringement, awarding 300,000 won of a 3 million won claim; the officer had received NHRCK human-rights education before the suit. National/Seoul-level — no North Gyeongsang content.

sources.title: Court rules against mandating transgender surgery to change legal sex status | Yonhap News Agency
sources.claim_summary: NOTE: page not retrievable at fetch time (navigation shell only; no article body preserved in cache); underlying Yonhap English wire, 8 May 2024, content not verifiable.

Hankyoreh (21 Mar 2024): a youth LGBTQ+ center surveyed 86 trans/genderqueer students — 69% did not feel comfortable using school restrooms, with students describing avoiding drinking to skip urination; a separate Busan study of 208 students found 39% mistreated at school over gender identity or sexual orientation. Advocacy targets the educational-facilities and school-health acts for gender-inclusive facilities. National-level — North Gyeongsang not covered.
